title: Intersection of planes
prompt: Two distinct nonparallel planes intersect. What is their intersection?
work: Two distinct nonparallel planes in Euclidean space share a line.
A perspective sketch cannot replace the intersection rule.

title: Determining a plane
prompt: Which given set determines a unique plane in Euclidean 3D space?
work: A unique plane passes through any three noncollinear points.
Collinear points lie on infinitely many planes.

title: Skew edges
prompt: Two infinite lines do not intersect and do not lie in one plane. Classify them.
work: Parallel lines are by definition coplanar.

title: Perpendicular lines
prompt: For two lines in 3D space to be perpendicular in the ordinary geometric sense, they must:
work: A drawing that only appears to show a right angle is insufficient.

title: Dihedral angle
prompt: How do you measure the dihedral angle between two half-planes with a common edge?
options: Angle of any lines drawn on the planes
Angle in a section perpendicular to the common edge
work: Construct a plane perpendicular to the shared edge.
The angle between the two intersection rays measures the dihedral angle.

title: Orthogonal planes
prompt: Two walls meet at a right angle. The interior dihedral angle between the walls equals:
work: Use a cross-section perpendicular to the line where the walls meet.

title: Euler face count
prompt: A convex polyhedron has 8 vertices and 12 edges. How many faces must it have?
work: Use the convex-polyhedron relation V − E + F = 2.

title: Pentagonal prism face count
prompt: A convex pentagonal prism has 10 vertices and 15 edges. Find the number of faces.

title: Internal box diagonal
prompt: A rectangular box has edges 3 m, 4 m, and 12 m. Find its space diagonal.

title: Cabinet cable
prompt: A cabinet measures 6 m × 8 m × 24 m. Find its corner-to-corner straight-line diagonal.

title: Planar section of box
prompt: A 6 cm by 4 cm rectangular base is sliced by a plane parallel to that base. Find the cross-sectional area.
work: A section parallel to the rectangular base is congruent to the base.

title: Cross section of a prism
prompt: A right prism has a rectangular base 5 m by 3 m. Find the area of a section parallel to its base.
work: Identify the rectangular section with dimensions 5 m and 3 m.

title: Prism lateral area
prompt: A right prism has base perimeter 14 m and perpendicular height 7 m. Find its lateral area.
work: For a right prism the lateral faces are rectangles.

title: Closed prism total area
prompt: A closed right prism has base perimeter 14 m, base area 12 m², and height 7 m. Find total surface area.
work: Use Sₜ = Ph + 2B for a closed right prism.

title: Prism capacity
prompt: A prism-shaped tank has base area 24 m² and perpendicular height 5 m. Find volume.
work: A prism has equal parallel base sections.

title: Storage vault
prompt: A right triangular prism has triangular base area 18 m² and length 7 m. Find its volume.
work: Use the triangular face as the base.

title: Skew prism volume
prompt: An oblique prism has base area 20 cm², perpendicular height 8 cm, and slant edge 10 cm. Find its volume.
work: Volume uses the perpendicular altitude, not the slant edge.

title: Tilted column
prompt: A tilted prism has base area 12 m² and perpendicular base separation of 9 m. Find volume.
work: The base sections remain congruent at every level.

title: Packaging box volume
prompt: A rectangular box measures 3 m × 4 m × 5 m. Find volume.
work: Its three mutually perpendicular edge lengths multiply.

title: Cuboid storage
prompt: A cuboid measures 5 cm × 6 cm × 7 cm. Find volume.

title: Paint a cylindrical wall
prompt: A right circular tank has radius 2 m and height 7 m. Find its lateral area only.
work: Unroll the curved surface into a 2πr by h rectangle.

title: Closed tank surface
prompt: A closed right cylinder has radius 3 m and height 6 m. Find total area including both ends.
work: Total area = curved area plus two circular ends.

title: Water tank volume
prompt: A circular cylinder has radius 3 m and height 5 m. Find its volume.
work: Multiply the circular base area by perpendicular height.

title: Vertical silo volume
prompt: A circular silo has radius 4 m and height 8 m. Find volume.

title: Oblique cylindrical vessel
prompt: An oblique circular cylinder has radius 2 m, slant generator 9 m, and perpendicular height 7 m. Find volume.
work: Discard the slant edge for volume; perpendicular height is 7 m.

title: Tilted cylinder volume
prompt: A tilted cylinder has circular radius 3 cm and perpendicular base-plane separation 10 cm. Find volume.
work: Cavalieri’s volume result applies despite the tilt.

title: Steel pipe wall volume
prompt: A pipe has outer radius 5 cm, inner radius 3 cm, and length 4 cm. Find metal volume.
work: Subtract the inner cylinder from the outer cylinder.

title: Hollow tube volume
prompt: A pipe has outer radius 6 cm, inner radius 4 cm, and length 5 cm. Find solid wall volume.

title: Regular pyramid slant height
prompt: A right regular pyramid has height 12 cm and base apothem 5 cm. Find face slant height.
work: Use the right triangle from apex, base center and side midpoint.

title: Pyramid cladding
prompt: A regular pyramid has base perimeter 24 m and common face slant height 10 m. Find lateral area.
work: Each side face is triangular, with height ℓ.

title: Pyramid sand volume
prompt: A pyramid-shaped pile has base area 36 m² and perpendicular height 9 m. Find volume.
work: V = one third of base area times altitude.

title: Pyramidal hopper
prompt: A pyramid hopper has base area 45 m² and vertical height 6 m. Find its capacity.

title: Oblique pyramid
prompt: An oblique pyramid has base area 30 m², perpendicular altitude 9 m, and slanted edge 11 m. Find volume.
work: Only the perpendicular altitude is used for volume.

title: Asymmetric pyramid
prompt: An irregular pyramid has base area 48 cm² and perpendicular height 6 cm. Find volume.
work: Volume does not require the base to be regular.

title: Cone slant height
prompt: A right circular cone has radius 5 cm and height 12 cm. Find slant height.
work: The slant generator, height and radius form a right triangle.

title: Cone curved surface
prompt: A right cone has base radius 4 cm and slant height 5 cm. Find lateral area.
work: Use Sₗ = πrℓ for a right circular cone.

title: Cone storage capacity
prompt: A cone has radius 3 m and perpendicular height 8 m. Find volume.
work: A cone has one third the volume of the cylinder with matching base and altitude.

title: Closed conical hopper area
prompt: A closed right cone has radius 3 m and height 4 m. Find its total exterior area including the circular base.
work: Compute slant height first: ℓ = √(3² + 4²) = 5 m.

title: Leaning cone volume
prompt: An oblique circular cone has base radius 3 m and perpendicular height 9 m. Find volume.
work: The cone can lean: base area and perpendicular height determine its volume.

title: Skew cone volume
prompt: An oblique cone has base radius 2 m, vertical height 12 m and a slant edge of 13 m. Find volume.
work: Do not use the slant generator as the perpendicular altitude.

title: Tapered vessel volume
prompt: A conical frustum has lower radius 5 m, upper radius 2 m and perpendicular height 9 m. Find volume.
work: Use the frustum formula with both radii and perpendicular altitude.

title: Frustum sheet metal
prompt: A right conical frustum has radii 6 m and 2 m and perpendicular height 3 m. Find lateral area.

title: Pyramid pedestal
prompt: A frustum cut parallel to a pyramid base has end areas 36 m² and 16 m², and height 9 m. Find volume.

title: Truncated square pyramid
prompt: A pyramidal frustum has parallel end areas 64 m² and 16 m², and height 6 m. Find its volume.

title: Spherical shell exterior
prompt: A sphere has radius 3 m. Find full spherical surface area.
work: All of the sphere is curved; there are no flat faces.

title: Sphere capacity
prompt: A spherical container has inside radius 4 m. Find enclosed volume.

title: Hemispherical dome
prompt: A hemispherical roof has radius 5 m. Find curved roof surface only.
work: Half the sphere area gives the curved hemisphere.

title: Closed hemispherical container
prompt: A hemispherical shell plus its closing flat disk has radius 4 m. Find total surface area.
work: Curved half-sphere area = 2πR², base disk = πR².

title: Ball inside cube
prompt: A sphere fits exactly inside a cube of side 10 cm touching all six faces. Find the sphere radius.
work: The sphere diameter equals the cube edge.

title: Sphere around cube
prompt: A sphere passes through all eight vertices of a cube of side 6 cm. Find sphere radius.
work: The cube space diagonal is a√3, equal to sphere diameter.

title: Spherical cap finish
prompt: A sphere of radius 5 cm is cut by a plane leaving a cap of height 2 cm. Find curved cap area.
work: Cap height is measured along the sphere axis.

title: Cap storage volume
prompt: A spherical cap has sphere radius 6 cm and cap height 3 cm. Find cap volume.
work: Use V = πh²(R − h/3), with h within 0 to 2R.

title: Two-base spherical segment
prompt: A spherical segment has parallel cut circles of radii 2 cm and 3 cm and their planes are 4 cm apart. Find volume.
work: For a genuine spherical segment, V=πh(3a²+3b²+h²)/6.

title: Spherical sector
prompt: A spherical sector associated with a cap of height 2 cm on a sphere of radius 5 cm has what volume?

title: Regular tetrahedron solid
prompt: A regular tetrahedron has edge length 6 cm. Find its volume.
work: Use the regular tetrahedron formula V = a³/(6√2).

title: Tetrahedron sheet area
prompt: A regular tetrahedron has edge 4 cm. Find total area of its four congruent faces.
work: Four equal faces give S = √3(4²)=16√3 cm².

title: Ellipsoidal vessel
prompt: An ellipsoid has perpendicular semiaxes 3 m, 4 m, and 5 m. Find its volume.
work: Use all three semiaxes, not full axis lengths.

title: Oval buoy capacity
prompt: An ellipsoid has semiaxes 2 cm, 3 cm and 6 cm. Find volume.

title: Torus ring volume
prompt: A ring torus has major radius 5 cm and tube radius 2 cm. Find volume.
work: Ring torus requires major radius greater than minor radius.

title: Rubber ring surface
prompt: A ring torus has major radius 6 cm and tube radius 1.5 cm. Find exposed area.

title: Composite solid volume
prompt: Two disjoint components of a storage assembly have volumes 40 m³ and 18 m³. Find their combined volume.

title: Combined vessel portions
prompt: Two nonoverlapping chambers of an assembly hold 75 L and 25 L. Find total capacity.
work: Add disjoint capacity volumes in the same units.

title: Bored metal block
prompt: A 10 cm by 8 cm by 6 cm block is drilled by a radius-2 cm cylindrical through-hole spanning the 6 cm thickness. Find remaining volume.
work: Hole volume is π(2²)(6) = 24π cm³; remainder 480−24π cm³.

title: Cube through-hole
prompt: A cube has side 6 cm and is drilled straight through perpendicular to a face with a cylindrical hole radius 1 cm. Find remaining solid volume.
work: Cube volume = 216 cm³; hole spans 6 cm.

title: Scaled prototype volume
prompt: A prototype holds 12 L. A geometrically similar model doubles every length. Find the new volume.
work: Similar solid volume varies as length scale cubed.

title: Scaled surface finish
prompt: A geometrically similar enlargement triples all lengths. An original solid has area 10 m². Find new area.
work: Surface area varies as the square of linear scale.

title: Truncated cone removal
prompt: A cone of base radius 6 cm and height 12 cm has its tip removed by a parallel cut. The removed small cone has radius 3 cm and height 6 cm. Find remaining volume.
work: Removed small cone V = π(3²)(6)/3 = 18π; remaining 126π cm³.

title: Prismatic wedge
prompt: A triangular wedge has perpendicular triangular cross-section with base 6 m and altitude 4 m, extended 5 m. Find volume.

title: Revolving a rectangle
prompt: Rotate the rectangular region 0 ≤ x ≤ 5, 0 ≤ y ≤ 2 about the x-axis. Find the generated volume.
work: Rotation makes a solid cylinder with r=2 and axial length=5.

title: Cylindrical shells
prompt: Rotate the region 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, 0 ≤ y ≤ 3 about the y-axis. Find the generated volume.

title: Cavalieri matching sections
prompt: Two solids have equal perpendicular altitude of 8 cm and each corresponding horizontal section has area 12 cm². Find the volume of either.
work: Section areas match at all levels and are constant.

title: Same sections, different lean
prompt: A right and an oblique prism share a base area of 15 cm² and perpendicular height 6 cm. Find either volume.
work: Sections at every corresponding level have the same area.
By Cavalieri, both volumes equal 15(6)=90 cm³.

title: Earthworks prismoid
prompt: For a true prismoid with quadratic cross-sectional area variation, end areas are 16 m² and 36 m², midsection area is 25 m², and length 12 m. Find volume.
work: Only apply the prismoidal formula with the stated quadratic-section condition.

title: Prismoidal excavation
prompt: For a solid meeting the prismoidal formula requirements, end areas 9 m² and 25 m², midpoint area 16 m², and height 6 m. Find volume.

title: Centroid volume sweep
prompt: A plane area of 6 cm² is revolved once around a coplanar external axis 5 cm from its centroid. Find swept volume.
work: The axis does not intersect the region and rotation has no overlap.

title: Pappus toroidal volume
prompt: A plane region of area 8 cm² rotates once about an external coplanar axis, its centroid being 3 cm from the axis. Find volume.

title: Centroid surface sweep
prompt: A plane curve length 10 cm revolves once around a coplanar nonintersecting axis 4 cm from its centroid. Find surface area.
work: For a non-self-overlapping swept surface, use S=L·2πd.

title: Revolved curve surface
prompt: A curve 6 cm long rotates about an external coplanar axis 7 cm from its centroid. Find resulting area.
work: Curve and axis do not intersect and sweep does not overlap.

title: Tank volume to liters
prompt: A tank has internal capacity 1.25 m³. Convert its full capacity to liters.

title: Half-full horizontal tank
prompt: A horizontal right circular cylinder has internal radius 1 m and length 4 m and is filled exactly to the centerline. Find contained water in liters.
work: Half depth through a horizontal circle gives half the cross-sectional area.

title: Metal pipe material mass
prompt: A component contains 0.02 m³ of steel of uniform density 7850 kg/m³. Find material mass.
work: Apply m=ρV with units kg/m³ × m³.

title: Enclosure sheet cost
prompt: Sheet metal is priced at 25 currency units per m². An enclosure requires 14 m² of sheet, ignoring waste. Find material cost.
work: For area-based pricing, cost = unit price × area.

title: Optimized closed cylinder
prompt: A closed circular cylinder has the surface-area-minimizing proportion for a fixed volume. Its radius is 3 cm. Find height.
work: For an unrestricted closed right circular cylinder, optimal h=2r.

title: Minimum-metal cylinder
prompt: A fully closed right cylinder has fixed volume 54π cm³ and minimizes total area. Find optimum radius.
work: At the minimum, h=2r so V=πr²(2r)=2πr³.

title: Cubic millimeters to cubic meters
prompt: Convert 2,000,000 mm³ to m³.

title: Square centimeters to square meters
prompt: Convert 50,000 cm² to m².
